devasthanName: Shri Kshetra Macchindranath Sanjivani Samadhi Mandir
aboutTempleContent1: Shri Kshetra Macchindranath Sanjivani Samadhi Mandir is a revered temple located in Sawaragaon, Ashti, in the Beed district of Maharashtra. The temple is dedicated to Lord Macchindranath, a revered saint and spiritual figure. The temple is known for its serene atmosphere and spiritual significance, attracting devotees from all over the region. It serves as a place of worship, meditation, and community gatherings, fostering a sense of devotion and spirituality among its visitors.
aboutTempleContent2: The saga of Lord Machhindranath (also known as Matsyendranath) begins in the primordial era. According to the sacred Puranas, while Lord Shiva (Adinath) was revealing the secret of Brahmavidya and Yoga to Goddess Parvati on the banks of the cosmic ocean, a fish in the water listened with absolute stillness and devotion. Upon realizing the fish had attained divine enlightenment, Lord Shiva transformed it into a celestial mahayogi. Thus, he was named Machhindranath—the first human Guru of the Nath Sampradaya, born directly from the grace of Mahadev.

paushyaAmavasyaText: Paushya Amavasya marks the sacred day when Lord Macchindranath took Sanjivan Samadhi, entering eternal meditation at His holy resting place. On this auspicious occasion, a grand Chhabina procession and traditional Hanganma celebrations are held, as devotees gather with deep devotion to offer prayers and seek divine blessings at the Samadhi Sthal. The temple is beautifully decorated, and special rituals are performed to commemorate this auspicious occasion.
falgunAmavasyaText: On this sacred day, the holy Samadhi of Lord Macchindranath is opened once a year. At 1:00 PM, it is bathed with Ganga and other sacred waters, and at 4:00 PM, lakhs of devotees offer fragrant masala and chandan lep before it is respectfully covered before sunrise on Gudi Padwa.
rangPanchamiText: On the auspicious days of Chaturthi, Rang Panchami, and Nath Shashti, lakhs of devotees from Maharashtra and across the state gather with “Manache Nishan,” arriving with great devotion and celebration to seek the divine darshan of Shri Machchindranath’s sacred Samadhi.
rushiPanchamiText: Rushi Panchami celebrates the divine birth of Lord Macchindranath, the great yogi and spiritual guide. On this auspicious day, devotees offer prayers, bhajans, and heartfelt devotion in honor of His sacred incarnation.
monthlyAmavasyaText: On the day of Amavasya, devotees gather at the temple to offer their prayers and seek blessings. The temple is beautifully decorated, and special rituals are performed to commemorate this auspicious occasion. Devotees participate in various religious activities, including offering flowers, lighting lamps, and performing puja to honor Lord Macchindranath and seek his divine blessings.
